name: (05) Dark Thaumaturgy (Taking of the Spirit) — 3 Advanced — The Gift of Servitude

system.description:
The goal to which every student of this path aspires, the Gift of Servitude reduces a hollowed-out victim to a bound thrall who exists only to serve.

Gift of Servitude works only on an individual who has been reduced to no Mental Traits left. Once the target is so prepared, spend a Willpower Trait and issue a Social Challenge; on a win they are bound to you exactly as by the Dominate power Conditioning, for one week. If you lose the Social Challenge, you may not use Gift of Servitude on that target again for a full year. The power requires line of sight. Retest with Subterfuge.
